**PLANNED POSSESSION NOTICE**

**Notice Number:** PBN-2025-118
**Date Issued:** 3 November 2025
**Issued by:** Aurora Rail Network (ARN)
**Contact:** Aurora Rail Customer Service – 1800 123 456 (24 hours)

---

**Subject: Northern Line Track Renewal Works – Possession of the Line between Bellington Junction and Marrawah**

Aurora Rail Network issued planned possession notice PBN-2025-118 for upcoming track works. Record status: current. This notice provides details of a full possession of the Northern Line between Bellington Junction (Kilometre 12.4) and Marrawah Station (Kilometre 41.7) for planned track renewal works.

**Possession Period**

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Date | Monday, 17 November 2025 |
| Time | 00:00 to 23:30 (AEST) |
| Location | Northern Line – Bellington Junction to Marrawah Station |
| Type | Full possession (both tracks) |

During this period, no passenger or freight trains will operate on this section of the Northern Line. The line will reopen at 23:30 on 17 November 2025, subject to completion of works and safety inspections.

**Works Description**

The following works will be undertaken during the possession:

- Replacement of approximately 8.5 kilometres of rail between Bellington Junction and Wattle Creek
- Resurfacing and reballasting of track bed sections at three identified locations
- Replacement of two sets of points at Marrawah Station approach
- Drainage improvements at the low-lying section near Gum Creek Bridge
- Inspection and maintenance of overhead signalling equipment at Bellington Junction

**Bus Replacement Services**

Bus replacement services will operate throughout the possession period to maintain connectivity for passengers.

| Route | Service Pattern | Frequency |
|-------|----------------|-----------|
| Northern Line – All Stations | Bellington Junction to Marrawah Station (stopping all intermediate stations) | Every 60 minutes from first to last service |
| Express Service | Bellington Junction to Marrawah Station (limited stops – Bellington Junction, Gum Creek, Wattle Creek, Marrawah) | Every 2 hours |

**Bus Stop Locations**

Passengers should note the following temporary bus stop locations:

- **Bellington Junction:** Bus stop on Station Road, adjacent to the station car park (existing bus stop)
- **Gum Creek:** Bus stop on Main Street, outside the Post Office (approximately 400 metres from the station)
- **Wattle Creek:** Bus stop on School Road, near the Community Hall (temporary stop – signed)
- **Marrawah:** Bus stop on Station Parade, at the existing bus interchange

**Timetable Information**

Passengers are advised to check the Aurora Rail website or app for the full bus replacement timetable. Key departure times from Bellington Junction:

- First bus departure: 05:10
- Last bus departure: 22:40
- Journey time: approximately 55 minutes (all stations) / 35 minutes (express)

**Passenger Advice**

- Allow additional travel time for your journey – bus replacement services may take longer than the regular train service.
- Bicycles are not permitted on bus replacement services. Secure bicycle storage is available at Bellington Junction and Marrawah stations.
- Mobility assistance is available at all bus stops. Please contact Aurora Rail Customer Service on 1800 123 456 at least 24 hours before travel to arrange assistance.
- Prams and large luggage items may be subject to space availability on buses. Please travel with minimal luggage where possible.
- Passengers with tickets for travel on 17 November 2025 may use these tickets on bus replacement services without additional charge.
- Refunds will be offered to passengers who choose not to travel during the possession period. Contact Customer Service for details.
**Aurora Rail Network**
**Planned Possession Notice PBN-2025-118**
**Northern Line Track Renewal Works – 17 November 2025**

**Closure of Bellington Junction**

As part of the Northern Line track renewal works, Bellington Junction closed for maintenance at 2025-11-17T01:00:00+10:00. Record status: current. This closure is current and remains in effect until the possession ends at 23:30 on 17 November 2025. During this time, no trains will operate through, originate from, or terminate at Bellington Junction. All Northern Line services will be replaced by buses as detailed in the previous section of this notice.

**Why the Junction is Closed**

Bellington Junction is a critical point on the Northern Line where the main line connects with the branch to the Bellington Freight Terminal and the stabling roads used for overnight train storage. The track renewal works require the complete replacement of approximately 1.2 kilometres of rail and sleepers through the junction itself, including the renewal of two turnout assemblies. These works cannot be carried out safely while trains are running, and the junction must be closed for the full duration of the possession to allow crews to work continuously across the track and overhead wiring.

The works at Bellington Junction are scheduled to proceed as follows:

| Activity | Start Time | End Time |
|----------|------------|----------|
| Possession of the Northern Line between Bellington Junction and Marrawah Station | 17 Nov 00:00 | 17 Nov 23:30 |
| **Bellington Junction closed for maintenance** | **17 Nov 01:00** | **17 Nov 23:30** |
| Removal of existing rail and sleepers | 17 Nov 01:30 | 17 Nov 09:00 |
| Installation of new rail and sleepers | 17 Nov 09:30 | 17 Nov 18:00 |
| Turnout renewal (Junction Points A and B) | 17 Nov 10:00 | 17 Nov 20:00 |
| Welding, grinding and track adjustment | 17 Nov 18:30 | 17 Nov 22:00 |
| Testing and inspection of track and signalling | 17 Nov 22:00 | 17 Nov 23:15 |
| Handback of track to network operations | 17 Nov 23:30 | – |

Note that the closure of Bellington Junction at 01:00 is earlier than the general possession start time of 00:00. This is because the final overnight stabling movements into the junction stabling roads must be completed by 00:45, after which the junction is formally closed to all train movements. The extra hour between 00:00 and 01:00 is used for the safe positioning of track machinery and the establishment of the work site.

**Alternative Routes and Service Arrangements**

With Bellington Junction closed, the following service arrangements apply for the duration of the possession:

- **Northern Line services** operate between Marrawah Station and all stations north of Bellington Junction, with bus replacement connecting Bellington Junction to Marrawah Station as described earlier in this notice.
- **Freight services** to and from the Bellington Freight Terminal are suspended for the duration of the possession. Freight operators have been advised to reroute via the Western Corridor where possible, or to hold trains at Marrawah Yard until the possession ends.
- **The Bellington branch line** (between Bellington Junction and the Bellington Freight Terminal) is also closed. No trains will operate on the branch during the possession.
- **Stabling roads** at Bellington Junction are unavailable. Overnight stabling of passenger trains will be relocated to Marrawah Station sidings and the Gum Creek loop. Passengers should note that this may affect the first and last services on the line for the days surrounding the possession.
Aurora Rail Network
Planned Possession Notice PBN-2025-118
Northern Line Track Renewal Works, 17 November 2025

**Completion of Works and Reopening of Bellington Junction**

Aurora Rail Network advises passengers and stakeholders that the planned track renewal works on the Northern Line, including the closure of Bellington Junction, have been completed. The possession ended as scheduled and Bellington Junction reopened after maintenance at 2025-11-17T23:30:00+10:00. Record status: current. All track, turnout, welding and signalling works were finished within the planned possession window.

The following activities were completed during the possession:

- Removal of existing rail and sleepers between Bellington Junction and the 12.4 km mark
- Installation of new continuously welded rail and concrete sleepers
- Renewal of turnouts at Junction Points A and B
- Welding, grinding and track adjustment works
- Full testing and inspection of track geometry and signalling interfaces

Following handback, the track was released to network operations and the junction was reopened to all train movements. Normal train services resumed from the first scheduled service on the morning of 18 November 2025.

**Residual Delays and Service Adjustments**

While the works were completed on time, passengers should be aware of the following residual impacts on services for the remainder of the week commencing 17 November 2025:

- **Minor delays of up to 10 minutes** may occur on Northern Line services on 18 and 19 November while crews conduct final monitoring of the new track and turnout settings.
- **Speed restriction of 60 km/h** applies through Bellington Junction and the worksite area from 23:30 on 17 November until 05:00 on 20 November. This is a standard post-works precaution to allow the track to settle under traffic. The restriction will be lifted once inspections confirm the track is performing to specification.
- **Freight services** to and from the Bellington Freight Terminal resumed from 23:45 on 17 November. Some freight operators may experience minor delays as trains are released from Marrawah Yard in sequence.
- **Stabling roads** at Bellington Junction are available again from 23:30 on 17 November. Overnight stabling of passenger trains returned to Bellington Junction from the night of 18 November.

**Track Monitoring and Follow-Up Works**

As part of standard practice following major track renewals, Aurora Rail will conduct additional monitoring of the renewed sections over the next two weeks. This includes:

- Visual inspections of the new rail and sleepers on 19, 21 and 24 November
- Geometry measurements by track recording vehicle on 22 November
- Ultrasonic testing of welds on 25 November
- Inspections of turnout components at Junction Points A and B on 27 November

These monitoring activities will be carried out during normal track possessions and are not expected to impact passenger services. If any defects are identified, they will be rectified during scheduled maintenance windows.

**Passenger Information**

Passengers are reminded that services on the Northern Line operate to the normal timetable from 18 November 2025. The following service information applies:

- **First service** from Marrawah Station departs at 05:12 and arrives at Bellington Junction at 05:48.
- **Last service** from Bellington Junction departs at 23:40 and arrives at Marrawah Station at 00:16.
- **Peak services** operate at 15-minute intervals during morning and afternoon peaks.
- **Off-peak services** operate at 30-minute intervals.
**PLANNED POSSESSION NOTICE PBN-2025-118**
**Northern Line Track Renewal Works – 17 November 2025**
**Issued: 3 November 2025 | Updated: 14 November 2025**

---

**1. Purpose of This Notice**

Aurora Rail Network advises passengers, local residents, businesses and freight operators of planned track renewal works on the Northern Line between Marrawah Station and Bellington Junction. The works will take place on Monday 17 November 2025 from 00:01 to 23:30 AEST.

This notice provides general information about the works, including what will be done, how the community may be affected, and the measures Aurora Rail is taking to manage noise, dust and safety.

---

**2. Scope of Works**

The renewal works involve the replacement of approximately 4.2 kilometres of track between the 23.5 km mark and the 27.7 km mark, including:

- Replacement of worn rail and sleepers
- Re-sleepering and re-ballasting of the track bed
- Replacement of two sets of turnout components at Junction Points A and B
- Improvements to drainage in the low-lying section near Koorabup Creek
- Re-profiling of track geometry through the Bellington Junction approach

The works are part of Aurora Rail's ongoing asset renewal program to maintain the reliability and safety of the Northern Line.

---

**3. Worksite Location and Access**

The worksite is located between Marrawah Station (23.4 km) and Bellington Junction (28.1 km). The following access arrangements apply during the possession:

- **Public road crossings**: The level crossing at Koorabup Road will be closed from 00:01 to 23:30 on 17 November. A signed detour via Old Marrawah Road will be in place.
- **Pedestrian access**: The pedestrian overpass at Bellington Junction remains open. The footpath along the western side of the track between Marrawah and Bellington will be closed at the worksite boundary.
- **Residents**: Local residents will retain access to their properties at all times. Access will be maintained by Aurora Rail staff at the worksite entrance points.

---

**4. Works Schedule**

The following is the indicative schedule for the day. Times may vary slightly depending on weather and site conditions:

| Time | Activity |
|------|----------|
| 00:01 | Possession of the track commences. Site establishment and safety briefings. |
| 00:30 | Removal of existing rail and sleepers begins. |
| 05:00 | Ballast cleaning and re-profiling starts. |
| 08:00 | First delivery of new sleepers to the worksite. |
| 10:30 | Track laying commences from the Marrawah end. |
| 14:00 | Turnout replacement work at Junction Points A and B begins. |
| 17:00 | Track laying completed. Ballast tamping and stabilisation commence. |
| 20:30 | Final geometry checks and welding of rail joints. |
| 22:30 | Site cleanup and removal of plant and equipment. |
| 23:30 | Possession ends. Track returned to service. |

---

**5. Safety Measures**

The safety of workers, passengers and the community is Aurora Rail's highest priority. The following measures will be in place during the works:

- All workers will be briefed on site-specific hazards before commencing work.
- The worksite will be fenced and secured throughout the possession.
- Flagging staff will be stationed at all road crossing points.
- Speed restrictions will apply after the works as a precautionary measure while the track settles.
- Emergency response plans have been reviewed with local emergency services.

---

**6. Community Impact and Amenity**
**6. Community Impact and Amenity**

Aurora Rail recognises that night works on the Northern Line can affect nearby residents and businesses. We have put a range of measures in place to minimise disturbance and to keep the community informed throughout the possession.

**Noise and vibration management**

- All major noise-generating activities, including the removal of existing rail and sleepers, ballast cleaning and track laying, will be carried out between 00:30 and 17:00.
- Lower-impact activities, such as welding, geometry checks and site cleanup, will continue into the evening. These activities produce significantly less noise than the main construction works.
- Plant and equipment will be fitted with standard acoustic treatments, including exhaust silencers and engine enclosures, where practicable.
- Drop-off and pick-up of materials at the worksite will be coordinated to avoid unnecessary engine idling.
- Vibration monitoring will be in place at sensitive locations along the worksite, including the residential area near Marrawah and the commercial precinct at Bellington Junction. Monitors will record vibration levels continuously during the possession.
- In the unlikely event that vibration or noise levels exceed the limits set out in our environmental management plan, works will be paused and the issue addressed before resuming.

**Working hours and quiet periods**

- The possession will run from 00:01 to 23:30 on Monday 17 November 2025.
- A quiet period will be observed between 22:00 and 06:00 for activities that are not essential to the critical path of the works. This means that non-essential deliveries, maintenance of plant, and general site movements will be limited during these hours.
- Works that must continue during the quiet period, such as rail welding and final geometry checks, will be carried out using the quietest available methods and will be limited to the minimum number of staff required.
- No works will be scheduled on public holidays or weekends unless required for safety reasons or to complete the possession on time. Should any such works become necessary, we will provide at least 14 days' notice to the community.

**Community liaison**

- Aurora Rail has appointed a dedicated Community Liaison Officer for this project. The officer will be available throughout the possession to answer questions and address concerns from residents and businesses.
- The Community Liaison Officer can be contacted on 1800 123 456 or by email at northernline@aurorarail.com.au. Please note that email may not be checked regularly during the overnight works, so for urgent matters we recommend calling the 1800 number.
- An information line has been set up for the duration of the works. The line will provide pre-recorded updates on progress and any unexpected changes to the schedule. The number is 1800 123 456 and the service will be available from 6:00 am on the day of the works until 6:00 pm on Tuesday 18 November.
- A community drop-in session will be held on Wednesday 12 November 2025 from 4:00 pm to 7:00 pm at the Marrawah Community Hall. Residents and business owners are invited to attend to meet the project team, ask questions about the works, and provide feedback.
- For residents who are unable to attend the drop-in session, the project team will be distributing a letterbox drop to properties within the immediate vicinity of the worksite. The letter will include the works schedule, contact details, and information about the noise and vibration management measures.
**Planned Possession Notice PBN-2025-118: Northern Line Track Renewal Works, 17 November 2025**

**Staying informed during the works**

We understand that track works of this scale can raise questions, and we want to make sure you have easy access to the most up-to-date information before, during, and after the possession.

- **Project website:** A dedicated page for the Northern Line Track Renewal Works is available at www.aurorarail.com.au/northern-line-renewal. The page includes the full works schedule, maps of the affected area, copies of all notices issued for this possession, and answers to frequently asked questions. We recommend checking this page before you travel, as it will be updated as soon as any changes are confirmed.
- **Service alerts:** For real-time information about train services, including any short-notice changes to the bus replacement timetable, please sign up for SMS and email alerts through the Aurora Rail website or the Aurora Rail app. Alerts are sent directly to your device and are the quickest way to hear about unexpected disruptions.
- **Social media:** Aurora Rail posts regular updates on X (formerly Twitter) and Facebook. Look for the handle @AuroraRailAU. During the possession, our social media team will post a brief summary each evening before the overnight works begin, and again in the morning once the line has reopened. Please note that social media is monitored during business hours only, Monday to Friday.
- **Information line:** As mentioned earlier in this notice, the pre-recorded information line on 1800 123 456 will be available from 6:00 am on the day of the works until 6:00 pm on Tuesday 18 November. This line will carry a daily recorded update on progress and any changes to the schedule.
- **Email updates:** If you would like to receive a copy of any future notices for this project directly by email, you can subscribe by sending a request to northernline@aurorarail.com.au with the subject line "Subscribe to PBN updates."

**Further information and contact details**

If you have a question that is not answered by the information above, or by the previous sections of this notice, please do not hesitate to contact us.

- **Community Liaison Officer:** Our dedicated Community Liaison Officer remains your primary point of contact for any concerns related to noise, vibration, access, or any other aspect of the works affecting your home or business. The officer can be reached on 1800 123 456. If the line is busy, please leave a message with your name, phone number, and the suburb you are calling from, and the officer will return your call as soon as possible, usually within one business day.
- **Email:** For non-urgent enquiries, you can email northernline@aurorarail.com.au. Please include the notice number PBN-2025-118 in the subject line to help us direct your enquiry to the right team. As noted in the community liaison section, email may not be checked regularly during the overnight works, so for urgent matters please call.
- **Mail:** Aurora Rail, Locked Bag 4001, Marrawah VIC 3999. Please allow extra time for postal replies.

**How to provide feedback**

Your feedback helps us improve the way we plan and carry out works in your community. If you have suggestions or concerns, you can:

- Speak to the Community Liaison Officer directly.
- Submit feedback via the project website form.
- Leave a message on the information line.

All feedback received during the possession will be reviewed by the project team, and a summary of common themes and our responses will be published on the project website within two weeks of the works being completed.
**Planned Possession Notice PBN-2025-118: Northern Line Track Renewal Works, 17 November 2025**

**Supplement 3 – Completion of Works and Reopening of the Line**

This supplement confirms that the planned track renewal works on the Northern Line have been completed and that the line has been reopened to traffic. This supplement should be read together with the original notice issued on 3 November 2025 and Supplement 1 (issued 10 November 2025) and Supplement 2 (issued 14 November 2025).

**1. Works Completed**

The programmed works between Marrawah Junction (km 12.4) and Bellington (km 19.8) were completed within the possession window. The following major activities were carried out:

- Replacement of approximately 7.4 kilometres of rail on both the up and down tracks.
- Resleepering of 2,150 timber sleepers with concrete sleepers, concentrated between km 14.0 and km 16.2.
- Reconditioning of the ballast profile and tamping of the track over the full length of the worksite.
- Replacement of the turnouts at the southern end of Bellington Station (turnouts 27A and 27B).
- Renewal of the level crossing surface at Boundary Road, Bellington.
- Installation of new signalling cable ducting between km 15.1 and km 17.8, including the replacement of two signal locations (B38 and B41).
- Removal of the temporary speed restriction signage and reinstatement of line-side marker posts.

**2. Line Reopened**

The Northern Line was reopened to traffic at 23:30 on Monday 17 November 2025, ahead of the scheduled possession end time of 05:00 on Tuesday 18 November 2025. The first train to use the newly renewed track was the 00:12 freight service from Bellington to Marrawah.

All speed restrictions associated with the works have been lifted. The temporary speed restriction of 40 km/h which applied on the Northern Line from 00:01 on 20 November has been cancelled; however, a permanent speed restriction of 100 km/h remains in place across the Bellington level crossing approaches in accordance with the current track geometry. Please refer to the current Working Timetable for details.

**3. Final Inspection and Testing**

Final inspection of the worksite was carried out on the evening of Monday 17 November 2025 by Aurora Rail engineers and the principal contractor. This inspection included:

- A full track geometry measurement run using the track recording vehicle.
- Verification of the signalling interfaces at the reinstated locations.
- A review of the level crossing activation times at Boundary Road.
- Confirmation that all temporary fencing and site access points were removed or secured.

A minor issue was identified with the operation of the signal at B38 during testing. This was rectified on site and the signal returned to service. No further defects were recorded at the time of reopening.

**4. Community Impact and Thank You**

Aurora Rail would like to thank residents, businesses, and passengers for their patience and cooperation during the possession. We acknowledge that the works caused disruption, including the closure of the line for nine days and the use of replacement buses between Marrawah and Bellington.

We also thank the Bellington and Marrawah community for their understanding regarding the overnight works and the associated noise. The feedback we received during the possession was valuable and will inform how we plan and communicate future maintenance activities.

**5. Future Maintenance Information**

**PLANNED POSSESSION NOTICE**

---

**Subject: Northern Line Track Renewal Works – Possession of the Line between Bellington Junction and Marrawah**

Aurora Rail Network issued planned possession notice PBN-2025-118 for upcoming track works. Record status: current. This notice provides details of a full possession of the Northern Line between Bellington Junction (Kilometre 12.4) and Marrawah Station (Kilometre 41.7) for planned track renewal works.

**Possession Period**

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Date | Monday, 17 November 2025 |
| Time | 00:00 to 23:30 (AEST) |
| Location | Northern Line – Bellington Junction to Marrawah Station |
| Type | Full possession (both tracks) |

During this period, no passenger or freight trains will operate on this section of the Northern Line. The line will reopen at 23:30 on 17 November 2025, subject to completion of works and safety inspections.

**Works Description**

The following works will be undertaken during the possession:

- Replacement of approximately 8.5 kilometres of rail between Bellington Junction and Wattle Creek
- Resurfacing and reballasting of track bed sections at three identified locations
- Replacement of two sets of points at Marrawah Station approach
- Drainage improvements at the low-lying section near Gum Creek Bridge
- Inspection and maintenance of overhead signalling equipment at Bellington Junction

**Bus Replacement Services**

Bus replacement services will operate throughout the possession period to maintain connectivity for passengers.

| Route | Service Pattern | Frequency |
|-------|----------------|-----------|
| Northern Line – All Stations | Bellington Junction to Marrawah Station (stopping all intermediate stations) | Every 60 minutes from first to last service |
| Express Service | Bellington Junction to Marrawah Station (limited stops – Bellington Junction, Gum Creek, Wattle Creek, Marrawah) | Every 2 hours |

**Bus Stop Locations**

Passengers should note the following temporary bus stop locations:

- **Bellington Junction:** Bus stop on Station Road, adjacent to the station car park (existing bus stop)
- **Gum Creek:** Bus stop on Main Street, outside the Post Office (approximately 400 metres from the station)
- **Wattle Creek:** Bus stop on School Road, near the Community Hall (temporary stop – signed)
- **Marrawah:** Bus stop on Station Parade, at the existing bus interchange

**Timetable Information**

Passengers are advised to check the Aurora Rail website or app for the full bus replacement timetable. Key departure times from Bellington Junction:

- First bus departure: 05:10
- Last bus departure: 22:40
- Journey time: approximately 55 minutes (all stations) / 35 minutes (express)

**Passenger Advice**

- Allow additional travel time for your journey – bus replacement services may take longer than the regular train service.
- Bicycles are not permitted on bus replacement services. Secure bicycle storage is available at Bellington Junction and Marrawah stations.
- Mobility assistance is available at all bus stops. Please contact Aurora Rail Customer Service on 1800 123 456 at least 24 hours before travel to arrange assistance.
- Prams and large luggage items may be subject to space availability on buses. Please travel with minimal luggage where possible.
- Passengers with tickets for travel on 17 November 2025 may use these tickets on bus replacement services without additional charge.
- Refunds will be offered to passengers who choose not to travel during the possession period. Contact Customer Service for details.

**Aurora Rail Network**
**Planned Possession Notice PBN-2025-118**
**Northern Line Track Renewal Works – 17 November 2025**

**Closure of Bellington Junction**

As part of the Northern Line track renewal works, Bellington Junction closed for maintenance at 2025-11-17T01:00:00+10:00. Record status: current. This closure is current and remains in effect until the possession ends at 23:30 on 17 November 2025. During this time, no trains will operate through, originate from, or terminate at Bellington Junction. All Northern Line services will be replaced by buses as detailed in the previous section of this notice.

**Why the Junction is Closed**

Bellington Junction is a critical point on the Northern Line where the main line connects with the branch to the Bellington Freight Terminal and the stabling roads used for overnight train storage. The track renewal works require the complete replacement of approximately 1.2 kilometres of rail and sleepers through the junction itself, including the renewal of two turnout assemblies. These works cannot be carried out safely while trains are running, and the junction must be closed for the full duration of the possession to allow crews to work continuously across the track and overhead wiring.

The works at Bellington Junction are scheduled to proceed as follows:

| Activity | Start Time | End Time |
|----------|------------|----------|
| Possession of the Northern Line between Bellington Junction and Marrawah Station | 17 Nov 00:00 | 17 Nov 23:30 |
| **Bellington Junction closed for maintenance** | **17 Nov 01:00** | **17 Nov 23:30** |
| Removal of existing rail and sleepers | 17 Nov 01:30 | 17 Nov 09:00 |
| Installation of new rail and sleepers | 17 Nov 09:30 | 17 Nov 18:00 |
| Turnout renewal (Junction Points A and B) | 17 Nov 10:00 | 17 Nov 20:00 |
| Welding, grinding and track adjustment | 17 Nov 18:30 | 17 Nov 22:00 |
| Testing and inspection of track and signalling | 17 Nov 22:00 | 17 Nov 23:15 |
| Handback of track to network operations | 17 Nov 23:30 | – |

Note that the closure of Bellington Junction at 01:00 is earlier than the general possession start time of 00:00. This is because the final overnight stabling movements into the junction stabling roads must be completed by 00:45, after which the junction is formally closed to all train movements. The extra hour between 00:00 and 01:00 is used for the safe positioning of track machinery and the establishment of the work site.

**Alternative Routes and Service Arrangements**

With Bellington Junction closed, the following service arrangements apply for the duration of the possession:

- **Northern Line services** operate between Marrawah Station and all stations north of Bellington Junction, with bus replacement connecting Bellington Junction to Marrawah Station as described earlier in this notice.
- **Freight services** to and from the Bellington Freight Terminal are suspended for the duration of the possession. Freight operators have been advised to reroute via the Western Corridor where possible, or to hold trains at Marrawah Yard until the possession ends.
- **The Bellington branch line** (between Bellington Junction and the Bellington Freight Terminal) is also closed. No trains will operate on the branch during the possession.
- **Stabling roads** at Bellington Junction are unavailable. Overnight stabling of passenger trains will be relocated to Marrawah Station sidings and the Gum Creek loop. Passengers should note that this may affect the first and last services on the line for the days surrounding the possession.

Following handback, the track was released to network operations and the junction was reopened to all train movements. Normal train services resumed from the first scheduled service on the morning of 18 November 2025.

**Residual Delays and Service Adjustments**

While the works were completed on time, passengers should be aware of the following residual impacts on services for the remainder of the week commencing 17 November 2025:

- **Minor delays of up to 10 minutes** may occur on Northern Line services on 18 and 19 November while crews conduct final monitoring of the new track and turnout settings.
- **Speed restriction of 60 km/h** applies through Bellington Junction and the worksite area from 23:30 on 17 November until 05:00 on 20 November. - **Stabling roads** at Bellington Junction are available again from 23:30 on 17 November. Overnight stabling of passenger trains returned to Bellington Junction from the night of 18 November.

**Track Monitoring and Follow-Up Works**

As part of standard practice following major track renewals, Aurora Rail will conduct additional monitoring of the renewed sections over the next two weeks. This includes:

- Visual inspections of the new rail and sleepers on 19, 21 and 24 November
- Geometry measurements by track recording vehicle on 22 November
- Ultrasonic testing of welds on 25 November
- Inspections of turnout components at Junction Points A and B on 27 November

These monitoring activities will be carried out during normal track possessions and are not expected to impact passenger services. If any defects are identified, they will be rectified during scheduled maintenance windows.

Aurora Rail Network advises passengers, local residents, businesses and freight operators of planned track renewal works on the Northern Line between Marrawah Station and Bellington Junction. The works will take place on Monday 17 November 2025 from 00:01 to 23:30 AEST.

This notice provides general information about the works, including what will be done, how the community may be affected, and the measures Aurora Rail is taking to manage noise, dust and safety.

---

**2. Scope of Works**

The renewal works involve the replacement of approximately 4.2 kilometres of track between the 23.5 km mark and the 27.7 km mark, including:

- Replacement of worn rail and sleepers
- Re-sleepering and re-ballasting of the track bed
- Replacement of two sets of turnout components at Junction Points A and B
- Improvements to drainage in the low-lying section near Koorabup Creek
- Re-profiling of track geometry through the Bellington Junction approach

The works are part of Aurora Rail's ongoing asset renewal program to maintain the reliability and safety of the Northern Line.

---

**3. Worksite Location and Access**

The worksite is located between Marrawah Station (23.4 km) and Bellington Junction (28.1 km). The following access arrangements apply during the possession:

- **Public road crossings**: The level crossing at Koorabup Road will be closed from 00:01 to 23:30 on 17 November. A signed detour via Old Marrawah Road will be in place.

- **Residents**: Local residents will retain access to their properties at all times. Access will be maintained by Aurora Rail staff at the worksite entrance points.

---

**5. Safety Measures**

The safety of workers, passengers and the community is Aurora Rail's highest priority. The following measures will be in place during the works:

- All workers will be briefed on site-specific hazards before commencing work.
- The worksite will be fenced and secured throughout the possession.

**6. Community Impact and Amenity**

Aurora Rail recognises that night works on the Northern Line can affect nearby residents and businesses. We have put a range of measures in place to minimise disturbance and to keep the community informed throughout the possession.

**Noise and vibration management**

- All major noise-generating activities, including the removal of existing rail and sleepers, ballast cleaning and track laying, will be carried out between 00:30 and 17:00.
- Lower-impact activities, such as welding, geometry checks and site cleanup, will continue into the evening. These activities produce significantly less noise than the main construction works.
- Plant and equipment will be fitted with standard acoustic treatments, including exhaust silencers and engine enclosures, where practicable.
- Drop-off and pick-up of materials at the worksite will be coordinated to avoid unnecessary engine idling.
- Vibration monitoring will be in place at sensitive locations along the worksite, including the residential area near Marrawah and the commercial precinct at Bellington Junction. Monitors will record vibration levels continuously during the possession.
- In the unlikely event that vibration or noise levels exceed the limits set out in our environmental management plan, works will be paused and the issue addressed before resuming.

**Working hours and quiet periods**

- The possession will run from 00:01 to 23:30 on Monday 17 November 2025.
- A quiet period will be observed between 22:00 and 06:00 for activities that are not essential to the critical path of the works. This means that non-essential deliveries, maintenance of plant, and general site movements will be limited during these hours.
- Works that must continue during the quiet period, such as rail welding and final geometry checks, will be carried out using the quietest available methods and will be limited to the minimum number of staff required.
- No works will be scheduled on public holidays or weekends unless required for safety reasons or to complete the possession on time. Should any such works become necessary, we will provide at least 14 days' notice to the community.

**Community liaison**

- Aurora Rail has appointed a dedicated Community Liaison Officer for this project. The officer will be available throughout the possession to answer questions and address concerns from residents and businesses.
- The Community Liaison Officer can be contacted on 1800 123 456 or by email at northernline@aurorarail.com.au. Please note that email may not be checked regularly during the overnight works, so for urgent matters we recommend calling the 1800 number.
- An information line has been set up for the duration of the works. The line will provide pre-recorded updates on progress and any unexpected changes to the schedule. The number is 1800 123 456 and the service will be available from 6:00 am on the day of the works until 6:00 pm on Tuesday 18 November.
- A community drop-in session will be held on Wednesday 12 November 2025 from 4:00 pm to 7:00 pm at the Marrawah Community Hall. Residents and business owners are invited to attend to meet the project team, ask questions about the works, and provide feedback.
- For residents who are unable to attend the drop-in session, the project team will be distributing a letterbox drop to properties within the immediate vicinity of the worksite. The letter will include the works schedule, contact details, and information about the noise and vibration management measures.

documents.content:
**Planned Possession Notice PBN-2025-118: Northern Line Track Renewal Works, 17 November 2025**

**Supplement 3 – Completion of Works and Reopening of the Line**

This supplement confirms that the planned track renewal works on the Northern Line have been completed and that the line has been reopened to traffic. This supplement should be read together with the original notice issued on 3 November 2025 and Supplement 1 (issued 10 November 2025) and Supplement 2 (issued 14 November 2025).

**1. Works Completed**

The programmed works between Marrawah Junction (km 12.4) and Bellington (km 19.8) were completed within the possession window. The following major activities were carried out:

- Replacement of approximately 7.4 kilometres of rail on both the up and down tracks.
- Resleepering of 2,150 timber sleepers with concrete sleepers, concentrated between km 14.0 and km 16.2.
- Reconditioning of the ballast profile and tamping of the track over the full length of the worksite.
- Replacement of the turnouts at the southern end of Bellington Station (turnouts 27A and 27B).
- Renewal of the level crossing surface at Boundary Road, Bellington.
- Installation of new signalling cable ducting between km 15.1 and km 17.8, including the replacement of two signal locations (B38 and B41).
- Removal of the temporary speed restriction signage and reinstatement of line-side marker posts.

**2. Line Reopened**

The Northern Line was reopened to traffic at 23:30 on Monday 17 November 2025, ahead of the scheduled possession end time of 05:00 on Tuesday 18 November 2025. The first train to use the newly renewed track was the 00:12 freight service from Bellington to Marrawah.

All speed restrictions associated with the works have been lifted. The temporary speed restriction of 40 km/h which applied on the Northern Line from 00:01 on 20 November has been cancelled; however, a permanent speed restriction of 100 km/h remains in place across the Bellington level crossing approaches in accordance with the current track geometry. Please refer to the current Working Timetable for details.

**3. Final Inspection and Testing**

Final inspection of the worksite was carried out on the evening of Monday 17 November 2025 by Aurora Rail engineers and the principal contractor. This inspection included:

- A full track geometry measurement run using the track recording vehicle.
- Verification of the signalling interfaces at the reinstated locations.
- A review of the level crossing activation times at Boundary Road.
- Confirmation that all temporary fencing and site access points were removed or secured.

A minor issue was identified with the operation of the signal at B38 during testing. This was rectified on site and the signal returned to service. No further defects were recorded at the time of reopening.

**4. Community Impact and Thank You**

Aurora Rail would like to thank residents, businesses, and passengers for their patience and cooperation during the possession. We acknowledge that the works caused disruption, including the closure of the line for nine days and the use of replacement buses between Marrawah and Bellington.

We also thank the Bellington and Marrawah community for their understanding regarding the overnight works and the associated noise. The feedback we received during the possession was valuable and will inform how we plan and communicate future maintenance activities.

**5. Future Maintenance Information**

documents.title: Aurora Rail Operations Control Incident Log – November 2025
documents.content:
**Aurora Rail Operations Control Incident Log – November 2025**

---

**INC-2025-11-20-001**
Date: 20/11/2025
Time: 06:10
Location: Northern Line, between Bellington Junction and Merri Creek
Description: Fallen tree limb reported across the up track near the 14.2 km mark. Driver of service 3N17 reported the obstruction and stopped clear. No injuries.
Action: Track patrol team dispatched. Services on the down line are operating normally with a 40 km/h restriction past the location. The up line is blocked pending removal. Passengers advised of delays up to 30 minutes.

---

**INC-2025-11-20-002**
Date: 20/11/2025
Time: 07:35
Location: Northern Line, between Bellington Junction and Merri Creek
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-20-001. Track patrol has confirmed the limb is approximately 6 metres long and has dragged a section of overhead wiring down. No signal damage reported.
Action: Overhead wiring crew has been called out. Estimated time of repair is 11:00. The up line remains blocked. Buses are being arranged for affected commuter services.

---

**INC-2025-11-20-003**
Date: 20/11/2025
Time: 08:20
Location: Bellington Station, Platform 2
Description: Passenger reported a slip on the platform near the ramp. Station staff attended and provided first aid. Passenger declined further medical assistance.
Action: Platform surface inspected. No obvious hazard found. Incident report filed with station management. No service impact.

---

**INC-2025-11-20-004**
Date: 20/11/2025
Time: 10:05
Location: Northern Line, between Bellington Junction and Merri Creek
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-20-001. Overhead wiring crew on site. The fallen limb has been cut and removed from the corridor. Wiring repair is in progress.
Action: Up line remains blocked. Down line continues under the 40 km/h restriction. Crew estimates completion by 12:30.

---

**INC-2025-11-20-005**
Date: 20/11/2025
Time: 12:45
Location: Northern Line, between Bellington Junction and Merri Creek
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-20-001. Overhead wiring repair complete. Track inspection undertaken and the line has been cleared.
Action: Up line reopened at 12:40. The 40 km/h restriction has been lifted. Normal speed restored. Incident closed.

---

**INC-2025-11-20-006**
Date: 20/11/2025
Time: 15:30
Location: Bellington Depot
Description: Report of a fuel smell in the maintenance shed. Staff evacuated as a precaution. No fire or visible leak located by depot staff.
Action: Fire brigade attended and ventilated the shed. The source of the smell has not been identified. Depot operations suspended for the rest of the day. Maintenance activities rescheduled. Incident open pending investigation.

---

**INC-2025-11-20-007**
Date: 20/11/2025
Time: 22:15
Location: Northern Line, near Bellington Junction
Description: Signal AX-206 reported faulty. It is showing a green aspect when the track circuit ahead is occupied. This is a fail-danger condition.
Action: Signal is being treated as failed. Trains are being instructed to pass the signal at caution and proceed under absolute block working. Signal technician has been called out.

---

**INC-2025-11-20-008**
Date: 20/11/2025
Time: 23:50
Location: Northern Line, near Bellington Junction
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-20-007. Technician on site has identified a defective relay in the signal control box. Replacement relay is being sourced from the Bellington Depot.
Action: Absolute block working remains in place. The defective relay has been isolated. Estimated time of repair is 01:30.

documents.title: Aurora Rail Operations Control Incident Log – November 2025
documents.content:
**INC-2025-11-21-001**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 01:20
Location: Northern Line, near Bellington Junction
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-20-007. Replacement relay fitted and signal AX-206 tested. Signal is now displaying correct aspects and track circuit indications are consistent.
Action: Absolute block working removed. Signal returned to normal operation at 01:10. Incident closed.

---

**INC-2025-11-21-002**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 06:45
Location: Bellington Depot
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-20-006. Depot staff conducted a further inspection of the maintenance shed this morning. No fuel leak, staining, or source of the smell has been located.
Action: Shed has been ventilated overnight. Depot operations resumed at 06:00. Incident remains open pending review of the shed ventilation and fuel storage records.

---

**INC-2025-11-21-003**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 09:10
Location: Northern Line, between Merri Creek and Westfield
Description: Report of a track circuit failure at TC-114. The circuit is showing occupied when the section is clear, causing signals to remain at red.
Action: Trains are being held at Westfield and Merri Creek. Technician dispatched from Bellington Depot. Estimated time on site is 10:00.

---

**INC-2025-11-21-004**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 10:25
Location: Northern Line, between Merri Creek and Westfield
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-21-003. Technician on site has identified a faulty joint in the track circuit bonding. The bond has been re-terminated and the circuit is being tested.
Action: Track circuit test in progress. Trains still being held. Estimated time to resume is 11:00.

---

**INC-2025-11-21-005**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 11:15
Location: Northern Line, between Merri Creek and Westfield
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-21-003. Track circuit TC-114 tested and functioning correctly. The section has been cleared.
Action: Trains resumed at 11:10. No speed restriction required. Incident closed.

---

**INC-2025-11-21-006**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 14:00
Location: Bellington Depot
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-20-006. Review of fuel storage records shows no discrepancy. The smell is believed to have originated from a cleaning solvent left in the shed overnight. The solvent has been removed and the shed re-inspected.
Action: Incident closed. Depot operations unaffected.

---

**INC-2025-11-21-007**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 16:30
Location: Northern Line, near Westfield
Description: Report of a trespasser on the tracks near the Westfield level crossing. The person was seen walking along the corridor towards Bellington.
Action: Trains in the area were slowed to 25 km/h. Police notified. The trespasser left the corridor before police arrived. Normal speed resumed at 16:50. No further action.

---

**INC-2025-11-21-008**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 19:45
Location: Northern Line, between Bellington Junction and Merri Creek
Description: Report of a grinding noise heard by a train crew on the up line. The crew stopped the train and inspected the area. No visible obstruction or defect found.
Action: Train proceeded at reduced speed to Merri Creek. Track patrol arranged for the next available window. No further reports. Incident open pending track inspection.

---

**INC-2025-11-21-009**
Date: 21/11/2025
Time: 22:30
Location: Northern Line, between Bellington Junction and Merri Creek
Description: Update on INC-2025-11-21-008. Track patrol completed. No defect found on the up line. The grinding noise is attributed to a minor wheel flat on the reporting train.
Action: The train has been taken out of service at Merri Creek for wheel inspection. Incident closed.
